description: PEL rights issue of 2019-12-30 (11 shares for every 83 held at Rs 1,300, record date 2019-12-31). The factor is the issue's TERP computed from the terms (Rs 1,300 = face value 2 + premium 1,298) and the previous cum close from the bhavcopy; NSE's own F&O circular NSE/FAOP/43038 (122/2019) gives the same inputs and AF 0.976143. Recorded PROVISIONAL; the circular is the evidence for verification.
formula: factor = TERP / P, TERP = (B x P + A x S) / (A + B); A new shares, B held, S the full issue price (face value + premium), P the previous cum-rights close (= ex-date PREV_CLOSE in the NSE bhavcopy)

resolutions.payment: Issue price Rs 1,300 per share (NSE circular 122/2019)
resolutions.limitation: the circular states the same P, S, A, B as the terms; its AF (0.976143) is the six-decimal rounding of the exact factor (0.97614282...). NOT yet verified: promote on the owner's decision.
